newsitem.title: USA: Illinois regulators to study natural gas industry.
newsitem.headline: Illinois regulators to study natural gas industry.

text.p: The Illinois Commerce Commission said Wednesday it adopted a resolution aimed at restructuring the natural gas industry in Illinois, which might eventually allow residential customers to choose their gas suppliers.

While industrial and larger commercial customers can already choose their suppliers, residential customers have never had the option to purchase gas from anyone other than the local distribution company, the ICC said in statement.
The commission is seeking public comment on issues relating to restructuring the natural gas industry. It will accept written comments from utilities through August 15.

The commission said it expects to approve a final report by early October. The report will include opportunities and possible obstacles to a restructuring, and necessary legislative changes. The report is expected to be sent to the governor and the Illinois legislature.

Last month, the commission approved a pilot program by Peoples Gas Light and Coke Co to test whether small-volume customers who currently buy gas from the utility, such as owners of smaller apartment buildings, would buy transportation service from the utility and the commodity from a marketer.
Results of the program will be provided to the commission. Peoples Gas is a subsidiary of Peoples Energy Corp.
